metadata.value: 该研究整合脑膜瘤空间转录组、空间蛋白、单细胞反卷积、复发演化和CRISPRi药物验证。

qa.question: 研究解决什么问题？
qa.answer: 高级别脑膜瘤内部存在显著空间异质性，现有WHO和分子分类会把生物学不同的区域或肿瘤归入同一组，也不清楚治疗后哪些亚克隆和通路扩张。研究寻找连接空间异质性、复发演化和可药物靶向依赖的机制。

qa.question: 核心数据是什么？
qa.answer: 研究分析9名患者的10个高级别脑膜瘤和16个样本，获得38,718个空间转录组区域、82个区域的72抗体空间蛋白数据，并纳入配对原发/复发及同一肿瘤不同区域；结果以seqIF、单细胞反卷积、502例bulk RNA和3D共培养验证。

qa.question: 模型或分析的输入与输出是什么？
qa.answer: 输入包括空间转录组、空间蛋白、DNA/RNA测序、甲基化、IHC、seqIF、单细胞参考和细胞共培养；分析输出区域基因程序、亚克隆CNV、MAPK与PI3K–AKT信号、免疫浸润和增殖状态，并通过CRISPRi与药物组合寻找可同时抑制异质亚群的方案。

qa.question: 主要生物学发现是什么？
qa.answer: 不同驱动事件的高级别脑膜瘤具有彼此分化的空间基因和蛋白程序。复发伴随耐药相关亚克隆CNV的空间扩张、免疫浸润和MAPK下降、PI3K–AKT及增殖上升；同一肿瘤不同区域也可由不同亚克隆和通路状态主导。

qa.question: 主要临床结果是什么？
qa.answer: 研究提示单点或bulk取样可能遗漏高风险亚克隆，空间异质性应纳入复发风险和治疗设计。基于患者特异异质性建立的3D共培养筛选发现联合用药可覆盖不同细胞亚群，但尚未进行患者前瞻性治疗验证。

qa.question: 最重要的限制是什么？
qa.answer: 空间深度研究队列很小且病例经过机制导向选择；不同平台的区域分辨率和取样不完全一致，复发关联不能完全分离治疗选择和自然演化；药物结果来自体外模型，不能直接等同于临床疗效。

overview.method: 多区域临床样本的分级、甲基化和DNA/RNA表征 → 空间转录组与72抗体空间蛋白发现分子异质性 → 比较不同驱动肿瘤、配对原发/复发和同瘤不同区域 → 用seqIF、单细胞反卷积和502例RNA队列验证 → 构建3D异质共培养 → CRISPRi和药理筛选联合方案
overview.story: 文章把脑膜瘤异质性分为分子、时间和空间三种尺度，并显示三者最终汇聚到亚克隆CNV、免疫浸润、MAPK/PI3K–AKT和增殖的区域组合。真正的治疗对象不是平均肿瘤，而是同一肿瘤内并存且可能在治疗后重新扩张的多个状态。

english.text: Intratumor heterogeneity underlies cancer evolution and treatment resistance, but targetable mechanisms driving intratumor heterogeneity are poorly understood. Meningiomas are the most common primary intracranial tumors and are resistant to all medical therapies, and high-grade meningiomas have significant intratumor heterogeneity. Here we use spatial approaches to identify genomic, biochemical and cellular mechanisms linking intratumor heterogeneity to the molecular, temporal and spatial evolution of high-grade meningiomas. We show that divergent intratumor gene and protein expression programs distinguish high-grade meningiomas that are otherwise grouped together by current classification systems. Analyses of matched pairs of primary and recurrent meningiomas reveal spatial expansion of subclonal copy number variants associated with treatment resistance. Multiplexed sequential immunofluorescence and deconvolution of meningioma spatial transcriptomes using cell types from single-cell RNA sequencing show decreased immune infiltration, decreased MAPK signaling, increased PI3K–AKT signaling and increased cell proliferation, which are associated with meningioma recurrence. To translate these findings to preclinical models, we use CRISPR interference and lineage tracing approaches to identify combination therapies that target intratumor heterogeneity in meningioma cell co-cultures.

chinese.text: 肿瘤内异质性是癌症进化和治疗耐药性的基础，但驱动肿瘤内异质性的靶向机制尚不清楚。脑膜瘤是最常见的原发性颅内肿瘤，对所有药物治疗均具有耐药性，且高级别脑膜瘤具有显着的瘤内异质性。在这里，我们使用空间方法来识别将肿瘤内异质性与高级别脑膜瘤的分子、时间和空间进化联系起来的基因组、生化和细胞机制。我们表明，不同的肿瘤内基因和蛋白质表达程序可以区分高级别脑膜瘤，而这些脑膜瘤通常被当前的分类系统分组在一起。对原发性和复发性脑膜瘤配对的分析揭示了与治疗耐药性相关的亚克隆拷贝数变异的空间扩展。使用单细胞 RNA 测序的细胞类型对脑膜瘤空间转录组进行多重连续免疫荧光和去卷积显示免疫浸润减少、MAPK 信号传导减少、PI3K-AKT 信号传导增加和细胞增殖增加，这些与脑膜瘤复发相关。为了将这些发现转化为临床前模型，我们使用 CRISPR 干扰和谱系追踪方法来确定针对脑膜瘤细胞共培养物中肿瘤内异质性的联合疗法。

To do so, we use spatial transcriptomic and protein profiling approaches to study clinical samples from high-grade human meningiomas (Fig. 1). When integrated with clinically established histological or bulk molecular approaches for meningioma classification6,14,21, such as multiplexed sequential immunofluorescence (seqIF) and spatial deconvolution of meningioma single-cell transcriptomes, our results elucidate how intratumor heterogeneity influences the molecular (Fig. 2), temporal (Figs. 3 and 4) and spatial evolution (Figs. 5 and 6) of the most common primary intracranial tumor1,2. source_fragments: To define mechanisms underlying meningioma intratumor heterogeneity and evolution, 16 intracranial samples from ten high-grade meningiomas (designated M1–M10) that were resected from nine patients were assembled for clinical, histological and molecular analyses (Fig. 1a and Supplementary Table 1). Histological and molecular analyses of all samples were performed using the most recent criteria from the World Health Organization (WHO) Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System14, including targeted next-generation DNA sequencing23 to define somatic short variants (SSVs) and copy number variants (CNVs) that are associated with high-grade meningioma classification and adverse clinical outcomes8,9,24–27 (Supplementary Tables 1 and 2). All samples were analyzed using immunohistochemistry for cell proliferation (Ki-67), cell cycle regulation (p16) and chromatin markers (H3K27me3), each of which can also be associated with clinical outcomes for patients with meningiomas28–30. DNA methylation grouping6 and targeted gene expression profiling21 were performed on all samples (Supplementary Tables 1 and 3). These comprehensive clinical, histological and molecular analyses identified clinical samples with suitable RNA content to study the molecular (M1–M3), temporal (M4–M7) and spatial evolution (M8–M10) of human meningiomas (Fig. 1b).

source_fragments: Spatial transcriptomic profiling of 50 μm regions from continuous arrays tiled across 6 mm cores was performed on all meningiomas using an approach that integrates approximately ten cells per capture area31 (Extended Data Fig. 1a). Core selection for each sample was guided by morphological or immunohistochemical heterogeneity of whole mount formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tumor sections. Spatial transcriptomes were aligned with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histological images using unique oligonucleotide barcodes corresponding to array positions (Extended Data Fig. 1b). The Harmony bioinformatic pipeline was used for sample integration and batch correction32 (Extended Data Fig. 1c), and uniform manifold approximation and projection (UMAP) analysis of 38,718 spatial transcriptomes demonstrated 30 spatial gene expression programs across 16 high-grade meningioma samples (range, 4–15 programs per sample) (Fig. 1c,d, Extended Data Fig. 2a–c and Supplementary Table 4). Six spatial gene expression programs that included transcriptomes from all samples were distinguished by enrichment of genes involved in neural development (SIM2 and VIT in C1 and C7), angiogenesis (THBS2 and HHIP in C3), meningeal homeostasis and neurotransmitter processing (PTGDS and LCNL1 in C5), bone differentiation (MAP1LC3C and ALPL in C9) and differentiation of the neural crest (S100A and S100B in C14), which is a multipotent embryonic cell population that gives rise to the meninges33,34 (Extended Data Fig. 2a–c and Supplementary Table 4).

english.text: The WHO defines meningioma grades according to histological features, such as mitotic count and brain invasion, and rare molecular features, such as CDKN2A/B homozygous deletions or hotspot TERT promoter mutations that are sufficient for diagnosis of WHO grade 3 meningioma14. Most WHO grade 1 meningiomas can be effectively treated with surgery or radiotherapy, but many WHO grade 2 or grade 3 (high-grade) meningiomas, which account for 20–30% of cases1,2, are resistant to treatment and cause significant neurological morbidity and mortality16. Morphological features can influence meningioma WHO grading, and rhabdoid morphology associated with an inactivating BAP1 mutation has also been associated with high-grade behavior36. Thus, current clinical classification systems group meningiomas with different oncogenic mutations into the same high-grade group, which may not provide an optimal framework for clinical trials. ). Results from high-grade meningiomas were compared to an additional 4,426 spatial transcriptomes from histologically defined WHO grade 1 meningiomas (LGM1 and LGM2) that lacked unfavorable CNVs or SSVs that are associated with adverse clinical outcomes (

chinese.text: WHO 根据组织学特征（例如有丝分裂计数和脑侵袭）以及罕见的分子特征（例如足以诊断 WHO 3 级脑膜瘤的 CDKN2A/B 纯合性缺失或热点 TERT 启动子突变）来定义脑膜瘤分级14。大多数 WHO 1 级脑膜瘤可以通过手术或放疗有效治疗，但许多 WHO 2 级或 3 级（高级别）脑膜瘤（占病例的 20-30%1,2）对治疗有抵抗力，并导致显着的神经系统发病率和死亡率16。形态特征可以影响脑膜瘤的 WHO 分级，与 BAP1 失活突变相关的横纹肌样形态也与高级行为相关36。因此，当前的临床分类系统将具有不同致癌突变的脑膜瘤分为同一高级别组，这可能无法为临床试验提供最佳框架。为了确定高级脑膜瘤是否与趋同或发散的肿瘤内基因或蛋白质表达程序相关，对来自三名不同患者的具有BAP1失活（M1）、CDKN2A/B纯合缺失（M2）或TERT启动子突变（M3）的高级脑膜瘤进行了空间基因组和生化机制研究（扩展数据图3a、b和补充表1）。将高级脑膜瘤的结果与来自组织学定义的 WHO 1 级脑膜瘤（LGM1 和 LGM2）的另外 4,426 个空间转录组进行比较，这些脑膜瘤缺乏与不良临床结果相关的不利 CNV 或 SSV（补充表 6）。

source_fragments: The WHO defines meningioma grades according to histological features, such as mitotic count and brain invasion, and rare molecular features, such as CDKN2A/B homozygous deletions or hotspot TERT promoter mutations that are sufficient for diagnosis of WHO grade 3 meningioma14. Most WHO grade 1 meningiomas can be effectively treated with surgery or radiotherapy, but many WHO grade 2 or grade 3 (high-grade) meningiomas, which account for 20–30% of cases1,2, are resistant to treatment and cause significant neurological morbidity and mortality16. Morphological features can influence meningioma WHO grading, and rhabdoid morphology associated with an inactivating BAP1 mutation has also been associated with high-grade behavior36. Thus, current clinical classification systems group meningiomas with different oncogenic mutations into the same high-grade group, which may not provide an optimal framework for clinical trials. To determine whether high-grade meningiomas are associated with convergent or divergent intratumor gene or protein expression programs, spatial genomic and biochemical mechanisms were studied across high-grade meningiomas harboring either a BAP1 inactivation (M1), CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion (M2) or TERT promoter mutation (M3) from three different patients (Extended Data Fig. 3a,b and Supplementary Table 1). Results from high-grade meningiomas were compared to an additional 4,426 spatial transcriptomes from histologically defined WHO grade 1 meningiomas (LGM1 and LGM2) that lacked unfavorable CNVs or SSVs that are associated with adverse clinical outcomes (Supplementary Table 6).

Nevertheless, local recurrence of high-grade meningioma is common15, and recurrence is the leading cause of death in patients with meningiomas that are resistant to standard interventions43. Mechanisms underlying meningioma resistance to treatment are poorly understood. Incorporation of CNVs can improve prognostic models for meningioma outcomes8,9, but the spatial architecture and evolution of meningioma CNVs over time is incompletely understood. To determine whether spatial expansion of subclonal CNVs underlies high-grade meningioma recurrence, inferCNV was used to deconvolve CNVs from paired primary and recurrent meningioma spatial transcriptomes (Extended Data Fig. 6a). These data suggest that regionally distinct meningiomas can be associated with divergent genomic features even within individual patients.

source_fragments: To determine whether the diverse genomic mechanisms underlying high-grade meningioma recurrence were associated with convergent or divergent biochemical and cellular phenotypes, spatial protein profiling (Fig. 4a and Extended Data Fig. 8a–d) was performed alongside multiplexed seqIF to stain and image whole mount sections of primary (M4–M7) and recurrent (M4′–M7′) meningiomas (Fig. 4b,c, Extended Data Fig. 8e and Supplementary Table 8). PCA of spatial protein profiling data demonstrated divergent biochemical mechanisms in primary versus recurrent tumors (Extended Data Fig. 8a,b), but inspection of individual proteins revealed conserved trends underlying high-grade meningioma recurrence (Extended Data Fig. 8c). Proteins associated with cell proliferation (Ki-67) and PI3K–AKT signaling (PLCG1) were enriched in recurrent meningiomas, whereas proteins associated with MAPK signaling (pan-Ras), immune signaling (CD45, VISTA and CD14) and PI3K–AKT inhibition (INPP4B) were suppressed in recurrent meningiomas (Fig. 4a and Extended Data Fig. 8d). In support of these findings, multiplexed seqIF showed that Ki-67 was enriched in recurrent versus primary meningioma cells that were marked by expression of SSTR2A44 (Fig. 4c). Primary meningiomas were enriched in pan-Ras, INPP4B, macrophages (CD68 and CD163) that were concentrated in the perivascular niche (CD31) and VISTA, an inhibitor of T cell activation (Fig. 4c). Meningioma responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors that target T cells19,20 appear less robust compared to other tumors for which such therapies are now standard of care45–52, and multiplexed seqIF showed that T cells marked by CD4 or CD8 were rare in either primary or recurrent meningiomas (Extended Data Fig. 8e). To validate these findings, meningioma cell types were deconvolved from spatial transcriptomes using single-cell RNA sequencing of 57,114 cells from eight meningioma samples representing all DNA methylation groups6. Spatial deconvolution of single-cell types showed that CD163 macrophages, differentiated meningioma cells, SSTR2A meningioma cells and G1 phase meningioma cells were decreased in recurrent versus primary meningiomas (Fig. 4d). Cycling G2M phase and S phase meningioma cells were enriched in recurrent versus primary meningiomas (Fig. 4d).

source_fragments: Histological analyses of M9 revealed a well-demarcated area of increased cellularity, increased immunostaining for Ki-67 and increased mitotic count that was sufficient for diagnosis of WHO grade 3 meningioma in one of two regionally distinct cores (Fig. 5a). Both cores from M9 otherwise had WHO grade 2 histology, lower immunostaining for Ki-67, hypermitotic meningioma DNA methylation grouping and high gene expression risk scores but showed divergent SSVs inactivating epigenetic regulators (ARID1A and ASXL1) and divergent CNVs deleting chromosomes 4 and 14q that were only identified in the core with WHO grade 3 histology (Fig. 1b). Histological analyses of M10 revealed WHO grade 3 meningioma with mosaic immunostaining for p16 that inversely correlated with immunostaining for Ki-67 in two regionally distinct cores (Fig. 5b and Extended Data Fig. 9b). Both cores from M10 were classified in the hypermitotic meningioma DNA methylation group but showed divergent gene expression risk scores and divergent CNVs amplifying chromosome 1q or deleting chromosomes 4q, 9p and 10q (Fig. 1b).

Cluster C8 correlated with intermediate immunostaining for p16 and demonstrated divergent cell signaling and proliferation genes (MET and EGFL6), which supports the hypothesis that regionally distinct mechanisms activating the cell cycle can exist in individual meningiomas (Fig. 2d,e). The remainder of M10 showed diffusely positive immunostaining for p16 and was enriched in senescence and cell cycle regulation genes (MX2 in C7, CDKN2B in C9 and C10). Multiplexed seqIF showed that Ki-67 was enriched in the WHO grade 3 region of M9 and in the region of M10 with reduced immunostaining for p16 (Fig. 6a–c). Moreover, M9 and M10 showed regionally distinct expression of pan-Ras, INPP4B, CD68, CD163, VISTA and the pericyte marker CD31. Spatial deconvolution of meningioma single-cell types6 validated regionally distinct changes in CD163 macrophages, pericytes, endothelia, SSTR2A meningioma cells, ECM remodeling meningioma cells and G1, G2M and/or S phase meningioma cells in M9 and M10 (Fig. 6d). Thus, in support of the genomic, biochemical and cellular phenotypes underlying the temporal evolution of high-grade meningiomas (Figs. 3 and 4 and Extended Data Figs. 5–8), regionally distinct cell proliferation, cell signaling and immune mechanisms underlie the spatial evolution of high-grade meningiomas.

sections.title_en: Personalized systemic therapy to overcome intratumor heterogeneity
sections.title_zh: 克服肿瘤内异质性的个体化系统治疗

english.text: Subclonal evolution underlies tumor recurrence and treatment resistance58–62, but preclinical models of intratumor heterogeneity or tumor evolution in response to treatment are lacking. To develop reagents to study high-grade meningioma heterogeneity and evolution in response to treatment, patient-derived WHO grade 2 M10G meningioma cells stably expressing CRISPRi machinery (M10GdCas9-KRAB)6,13 were transduced with sgRNAs suppressing the cell cycle inhibitors CDKN2A (sgCDKN2A) or CDKN2B (sgCDKN2B), the epigenetic regulator ARID1A (sgARID1A) or non-targeted control sgRNAs (sgNTC) (

). RNA sequencing of triplicate M10GdCas9-KRAB cultures revealed that CDKN2A/B suppression inhibited developmental and metabolic gene expression programs, whereas ARID1A suppression induced metabolic and mitotic gene expression programs (

). These data suggest drivers of high-grade meningioma intratumor heterogeneity may be associated with nonoverlapping therapeutic vulnerabilities. In support of this hypothesis, preclinical experiments demonstrate that meningiomas with loss of cell cycle regulators are susceptible to CDK4/6 inhibitors such as abemaciclib6, and meningiomas with loss of epigenetic regulators may be susceptible to histone deacetylase inhibitors such as vorinostat10.

chinese.text: 亚克隆进化是肿瘤复发和治疗耐药的基础58-62，但缺乏肿瘤内异质性或响应治疗的肿瘤进化的临床前模型。为了开发试剂来研究高级脑膜瘤异质性和治疗反应的进化，用抑制细胞周期抑制剂 CDKN2A (sgCDKN2A) 或 CDKN2B (sgCDKN2B)（表观遗传调节剂）的 sgRNA 转导稳定表达 CRISPRi 机制 (M10GdCas9-KRAB)6,13 的患者来源的 WHO 2 级 M10G 脑膜瘤细胞ARID1A (sgARID1A) 或非靶向对照 sgRNA (sgNTC)（扩展数据图 10a）。三份 M10GdCas9-KRAB 培养物的 RNA 测序表明，CDKN2A/B 抑制抑制发育和代谢基因表达程序，而 ARID1A 抑制则诱导代谢和有丝分裂基因表达程序（图 7a 和补充表 10）。这些数据表明，高级别脑膜瘤瘤内异质性的驱动因素可能与非重叠的治疗脆弱性有关。为了支持这一假设，临床前实验表明，细胞周期调节因子缺失的脑膜瘤对 CDK4/6 抑制剂（如 abemaciclib6）敏感，而表观遗传调节因子缺失的脑膜瘤可能对组蛋白脱乙酰酶抑制剂（如 vorinostat10）敏感。

source_fragments: Subclonal evolution underlies tumor recurrence and treatment resistance58–62, but preclinical models of intratumor heterogeneity or tumor evolution in response to treatment are lacking. To develop reagents to study high-grade meningioma heterogeneity and evolution in response to treatment, patient-derived WHO grade 2 M10G meningioma cells stably expressing CRISPRi machinery (M10GdCas9-KRAB)6,13 were transduced with sgRNAs suppressing the cell cycle inhibitors CDKN2A (sgCDKN2A) or CDKN2B (sgCDKN2B), the epigenetic regulator ARID1A (sgARID1A) or non-targeted control sgRNAs (sgNTC) (Extended Data Fig. 10a). RNA sequencing of triplicate M10GdCas9-KRAB cultures revealed that CDKN2A/B suppression inhibited developmental and metabolic gene expression programs, whereas ARID1A suppression induced metabolic and mitotic gene expression programs (Fig. 7a and Supplementary Table 10). These data suggest drivers of high-grade meningioma intratumor heterogeneity may be associated with nonoverlapping therapeutic vulnerabilities. In support of this hypothesis, preclinical experiments demonstrate that meningiomas with loss of cell cycle regulators are susceptible to CDK4/6 inhibitors such as abemaciclib6, and meningiomas with loss of epigenetic regulators may be susceptible to histone deacetylase inhibitors such as vorinostat10.

english.text: To identify pharmacologic strategies to inhibit intratumor heterogeneity in high-grade meningiomas, M10GdCas9-KRAB cells transduced with sgCDKN2A/B, sgARID1A or sgNTC were reciprocally labeled with red or green fluorescence proteins and assembled into 3D co-cultures for live cell microscopy. Abemaciclib blocked the growth of M10GdCas9-KRAB cells with CDKN2A/B suppression but did not block the growth of M10GdCas9-KRAB cells with ARID1A suppression or with expression of sgNTCs (

,c). Thus, to identify therapeutic vulnerabilities underlying meningiomas with loss of epigenetic regulators, spatial protein profiling was analyzed across 21 regions with or without SSVs inactivating ARID1A from M10 (

). These data revealed regionally distinct vulnerabilities to small molecule inhibitors of the DNA damage response (niraparib), EGFR signaling (erlotinib), MEK–ERK signaling (selumetinib), MET signaling (capmatinib) and PI3K–AKT signaling (copanlisib) (

). Vorinostat, niraparib, erlotinib, selumetinib and copanlisib blocked the growth of M10GdCas9-KRAB cells expressing sgNTC, and selumetinib and copanlisib blocked the growth of cells with ARID1A suppression (
). To determine whether combination molecular therapy could overcome intratumor heterogeneity in high-grade meningiomas, 3D co-cultures of M10GdCas9-KRAB cells expressing sgCDKN2A and sgNTC (

), were treated with abemaciclib and selumetinib, or abemaciclib and copanlisib. Combination molecular therapy blocked the growth of meningioma cells with loss of CDKN2A and loss of ARID1A in both co-culture conditions and attenuated the growth of meningioma cells expressing sgNTC (

,i). These findings were validated using the IOMM-Lee meningioma cell line63, which has loss of CDKN2A/B64, and SF12964 cells, which were derived from a WHO grade 3 meningioma with a homozygous CDKN2A/B deletion that developed resistance to abemaciclib in a patient who underwent reoperation for tumor progression6. Treatment of IOMM-Lee cells stably expressing CRISPRi machinery and sgARID1A or sgNTC again demonstrated that combination molecular therapy blocked the growth of all relevant clones in fluorescent 3D co-culture models (
–d). Abemaciclib, selumetinib and abemaciclib plus selumetinib had no effect on the growth of SF12964 cells, but copanlisib and abemaciclib plus copanlisib attenuated the growth of this cell line (

). Thus, high-grade meningiomas with loss of cell cycle and/or epigenetic regulators may be susceptible to combination molecular therapy blocking CDK4/6, MEK–ERK signaling and PI3K–AKT signaling, but heterogeneity across tumors suggests that individualized pharmacologic strategies may be necessary.

chinese.text: 为了确定抑制高级别脑膜瘤瘤内异质性的药理学策略，将用 sgCDKN2A/B、sgARID1A 或 sgNTC 转导的 M10GdCas9-KRAB 细胞用红色或绿色荧光蛋白相互标记，并组装成 3D 共培养物以用于活细胞显微镜检查。 Abemaciclib 通过 CDKN2A/B 抑制阻断 M10GdCas9-KRAB 细胞的生长，但不通过 ARID1A 抑制或 sgNTC 表达阻断 M10GdCas9-KRAB 细胞的生长（图 7b，c）。因此，为了确定表观遗传调节因子缺失的脑膜瘤的治疗脆弱性，我们对 21 个区域的空间蛋白分析进行了分析，无论是否有 SSV 使 ARID1A 从 M10 失活（图 1e）。这些数据揭示了DNA损伤反应（niraparib）、EGFR信号传导（erlotinib）、MEK-ERK信号传导（selumetinib）、MET信号传导（capmatinib）和PI3K-AKT信号传导（copanlisib）的小分子抑制剂的区域性独特脆弱性（图7d）。 Vorinostat、niraparib、erlotinib、selumetinib 和 copanlisib 阻断表达 sgNTC 的 M10GdCas9-KRAB 细胞的生长，selumetinib 和 copanlisib 阻断 ARID1A 抑制的细胞生长（图 7e）。为了确定联合分子疗法是否可以克服高级别脑膜瘤的肿瘤内异质性，用abemaciclib和selumetinib或abemaciclib和selumetinib治疗表达sgCDKN2A和sgNTC（图7f）或sgCDKN2A和sgARID1A（图7g）的M10GdCas9-KRAB细胞的3D共培养物。科潘利西布。在两种共培养条件下，组合分子疗法阻断了CDKN2A缺失和ARID1A缺失的脑膜瘤细胞的生长，并减弱了表达sgNTC的脑膜瘤细胞的生长（图7h，i）。这些发现使用 IOMM-Lee 脑膜瘤细胞系 63 和 SF12964 细胞进行了验证，该细胞具有 CDKN2A/B64 缺失，而 SF12964 细胞源自 WHO 3 级脑膜瘤，具有纯合 CDKN2A/B 缺失，在因肿瘤进展而接受再次手术的患者中产生了对 abemaciclib 的耐药性 6。对稳定表达 CRISPRi 机制和 sgARID1A 或 sgNTC 的 IOMM-Lee 细胞的治疗再次证明，联合分子疗法可阻断荧光 3D 共培养模型中所有相关克隆的生长（扩展数据图 10b-d）。 Abemaciclib、selumetinib 和 abemaciclib 加 selumetinib 对 SF12964 细胞的生长没有影响，但 copanlisib 和 abemaciclib 加 copanlisib 减弱了该细胞系的生长（扩展数据图 10e）。因此，细胞周期和/或表观遗传调节因子缺失的高级别脑膜瘤可能对阻断 CDK4/6、MEK-ERK 信号传导和 PI3K-AKT 信号传导的联合分子治疗敏感，但肿瘤之间的异质性表明个体化的药理学策略可能是必要的。

source_fragments: To identify pharmacologic strategies to inhibit intratumor heterogeneity in high-grade meningiomas, M10GdCas9-KRAB cells transduced with sgCDKN2A/B, sgARID1A or sgNTC were reciprocally labeled with red or green fluorescence proteins and assembled into 3D co-cultures for live cell microscopy. Abemaciclib blocked the growth of M10GdCas9-KRAB cells with CDKN2A/B suppression but did not block the growth of M10GdCas9-KRAB cells with ARID1A suppression or with expression of sgNTCs (Fig. 7b,c). Thus, to identify therapeutic vulnerabilities underlying meningiomas with loss of epigenetic regulators, spatial protein profiling was analyzed across 21 regions with or without SSVs inactivating ARID1A from M10 (Fig. 1e). These data revealed regionally distinct vulnerabilities to small molecule inhibitors of the DNA damage response (niraparib), EGFR signaling (erlotinib), MEK–ERK signaling (selumetinib), MET signaling (capmatinib) and PI3K–AKT signaling (copanlisib) (Fig. 7d). Vorinostat, niraparib, erlotinib, selumetinib and copanlisib blocked the growth of M10GdCas9-KRAB cells expressing sgNTC, and selumetinib and copanlisib blocked the growth of cells with ARID1A suppression (Fig. 7e). To determine whether combination molecular therapy could overcome intratumor heterogeneity in high-grade meningiomas, 3D co-cultures of M10GdCas9-KRAB cells expressing sgCDKN2A and sgNTC (Fig. 7f), or sgCDKN2A and sgARID1A (Fig. 7g), were treated with abemaciclib and selumetinib, or abemaciclib and copanlisib. Combination molecular therapy blocked the growth of meningioma cells with loss of CDKN2A and loss of ARID1A in both co-culture conditions and attenuated the growth of meningioma cells expressing sgNTC (Fig. 7h,i). These findings were validated using the IOMM-Lee meningioma cell line63, which has loss of CDKN2A/B64, and SF12964 cells, which were derived from a WHO grade 3 meningioma with a homozygous CDKN2A/B deletion that developed resistance to abemaciclib in a patient who underwent reoperation for tumor progression6. Treatment of IOMM-Lee cells stably expressing CRISPRi machinery and sgARID1A or sgNTC again demonstrated that combination molecular therapy blocked the growth of all relevant clones in fluorescent 3D co-culture models (Extended Data Fig. 10b–d). Abemaciclib, selumetinib and abemaciclib plus selumetinib had no effect on the growth of SF12964 cells, but copanlisib and abemaciclib plus copanlisib attenuated the growth of this cell line (Extended Data Fig. 10e). Thus, high-grade meningiomas with loss of cell cycle and/or epigenetic regulators may be susceptible to combination molecular therapy blocking CDK4/6, MEK–ERK signaling and PI3K–AKT signaling, but heterogeneity across tumors suggests that individualized pharmacologic strategies may be necessary.

english.text: Here we integrate spatial transcriptomics, spatial protein profiling, multiplexed seqIF and spatial deconvolution of single-cell transcriptomes across high-grade meningiomas to identify genomic, biochemical and cellular mechanisms linking intratumor heterogeneity to molecular, temporal and spatial evolution. Our results reveal divergent intratumor gene and protein expression programs to distinguish high-grade meningiomas that are otherwise grouped together by the WHO Classification of Central Nervous System Tumors14, one of the systems that is currently used to determine patient eligibility in clinical trials16.

chinese.text: 在这里，我们整合了高级别脑膜瘤中单细胞转录组的空间转录组学、空间蛋白质分析、多重 seqIF 和空间反卷积，以识别将肿瘤内异质性与分子、时间和空间进化联系起来的基因组、生化和细胞机制。我们的结果揭示了不同的肿瘤内基因和蛋白质表达程序，以区分高级别脑膜瘤，而这些脑膜瘤则按照世界卫生组织中枢神经系统肿瘤分类14进行分组，该分类是目前用于确定临床试验中患者资格的系统之一16。

source_fragments: Here we integrate spatial transcriptomics, spatial protein profiling, multiplexed seqIF and spatial deconvolution of single-cell transcriptomes across high-grade meningiomas to identify genomic, biochemical and cellular mechanisms linking intratumor heterogeneity to molecular, temporal and spatial evolution. Our results reveal divergent intratumor gene and protein expression programs to distinguish high-grade meningiomas that are otherwise grouped together by the WHO Classification of Central Nervous System Tumors14, one of the systems that is currently used to determine patient eligibility in clinical trials16.

english.text: Analyses of matched pairs of primary and recurrent meningiomas reveal spatial expansion of subclonal CNVs, decreased immune cell infiltration, decreased MAPK signaling, increased PI3K–AKT signaling and increased cell proliferation, which underlie treatment resistance and tumor recurrence. We identified divergent temporal evolution in recurrent versus primary meningiomas, suggesting that molecular analyses guiding clinical decision making should be performed on recurrent tumor tissue rather than archival samples from prior resections. Our results also indicate that regionally distinct spatial evolution represents a barrier to accurate tumor classification and should be considered during histological or molecular analyses of meningiomas.

chinese.text: 对匹配的原发性和复发性脑膜瘤对的分析揭示了亚克隆 CNV 的空间扩张、免疫细胞浸润减少、MAPK 信号传导减少、PI3K-AKT 信号传导增加和细胞增殖增加，这些都是治疗耐药和肿瘤复发的基础。我们发现复发性脑膜瘤与原发性脑膜瘤的时间演化存在差异，这表明应该对复发性肿瘤组织而不是先前切除的档案样本进行指导临床决策的分子分析。我们的结果还表明，区域不同的空间演化是准确肿瘤分类的障碍，在脑膜瘤的组织学或分子分析过程中应予以考虑。

source_fragments: Analyses of matched pairs of primary and recurrent meningiomas reveal spatial expansion of subclonal CNVs, decreased immune cell infiltration, decreased MAPK signaling, increased PI3K–AKT signaling and increased cell proliferation, which underlie treatment resistance and tumor recurrence. We identified divergent temporal evolution in recurrent versus primary meningiomas, suggesting that molecular analyses guiding clinical decision making should be performed on recurrent tumor tissue rather than archival samples from prior resections. Our results also indicate that regionally distinct spatial evolution represents a barrier to accurate tumor classification and should be considered during histological or molecular analyses of meningiomas.

english.text: More broadly, we show the feasibility of assessing spatially distinct subclones harboring prognostically relevant CNVs that could be considered as part of risk stratification algorithms for tumor grading. We find that regionally distinct high-grade meningioma samples displaying histological and molecular heterogeneity are associated with spatial gene expression programs that correlate with intratumor heterogeneity and cell proliferation.

chinese.text: 更广泛地说，我们展示了评估具有预后相关 CNV 的空间不同亚克隆的可行性，这些亚克隆可被视为肿瘤分级风险分层算法的一部分。我们发现，表现出组织学和分子异质性的区域不同的高级脑膜瘤样本与与肿瘤内异质性和细胞增殖相关的空间基因表达程序相关。

source_fragments: More broadly, we show the feasibility of assessing spatially distinct subclones harboring prognostically relevant CNVs that could be considered as part of risk stratification algorithms for tumor grading. We find that regionally distinct high-grade meningioma samples displaying histological and molecular heterogeneity are associated with spatial gene expression programs that correlate with intratumor heterogeneity and cell proliferation.

english.text: To translate these findings to preclinical models, we use CRISPRi and lineage tracing approaches in human meningioma co-culture models to identify combinations of FDA-approved molecular therapies that target intratumor heterogeneity and block meningioma growth. We show that this system can enable medium-throughput screening of pharmacologic strategies that may be useful for treating tumors that are resistant to standard interventions. Clinical trials of abemaciclib (NCT02523014) or selumetinib (NCT03095248) as monotherapy for meningiomas are ongoing, but our data suggest that combination molecular therapy may be necessary to target all relevant clones within a tumor rather than only the dominant clone, as is often done in clinical practice.

chinese.text: 为了将这些发现转化为临床前模型，我们在人类脑膜瘤共培养模型中使用 CRISPRi 和谱系追踪方法来确定 FDA 批准的针对肿瘤内异质性并阻止脑膜瘤生长的分子疗法的组合。我们表明，该系统可以实现药理学策略的中通量筛选，这些策略可能有助于治疗对标准干预措施耐药的肿瘤。 abemaciclib (NCT02523014) 或 Selumetinib (NCT03095248) 作为脑膜瘤单一疗法的临床试验正在进行中，但我们的数据表明，可能需要联合分子治疗来靶向肿瘤内的所有相关克隆，而不是像临床实践中经常采用的那样，仅靶向主要克隆。

source_fragments: To translate these findings to preclinical models, we use CRISPRi and lineage tracing approaches in human meningioma co-culture models to identify combinations of FDA-approved molecular therapies that target intratumor heterogeneity and block meningioma growth. We show that this system can enable medium-throughput screening of pharmacologic strategies that may be useful for treating tumors that are resistant to standard interventions. Clinical trials of abemaciclib (NCT02523014) or selumetinib (NCT03095248) as monotherapy for meningiomas are ongoing, but our data suggest that combination molecular therapy may be necessary to target all relevant clones within a tumor rather than only the dominant clone, as is often done in clinical practice.

english.text: In summary, our results establish a foundation for personalized systemic therapy to treat patients with high-grade meningiomas and provide a framework for understanding mechanisms and therapeutic vulnerabilities driving intratumor heterogeneity and tumor evolution.

chinese.text: 总之，我们的结果为治疗高级别脑膜瘤患者的个性化系统治疗奠定了基础，并为理解驱动肿瘤内异质性和肿瘤进化的机制和治疗脆弱性提供了框架。

source_fragments: In summary, our results establish a foundation for personalized systemic therapy to treat patients with high-grade meningiomas and provide a framework for understanding mechanisms and therapeutic vulnerabilities driving intratumor heterogeneity and tumor evolution.

english.text: This study complied with all relevant ethical regulations and was approved by the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) Institutional Review Board (13-12587, 17-22324, 17-23196 and 18-24633). As part of routine clinical practice at UCSF, all patients who were included in this study signed a written waiver of informed consent to contribute de-identified data to research projects.

chinese.text: 本研究符合所有相关伦理法规，并得到加州大学旧金山分校 (UCSF) 机构审查委员会 (13-12587、17-22324、17-23196 和 18-24633) 的批准。作为 UCSF 常规临床实践的一部分，参与本研究的所有患者都签署了一份书面弃权书，同意为研究项目贡献去识别化数据。

As part of routine clinical practice at UCSF, all patients who were included in this study signed a written waiver of informed consent to contribute de-identified data to research projects.

sections.title_en: Meningiomas, clinical data, histology and light microscopy
sections.title_zh: 脑膜瘤、临床数据、组织学和光学显微镜检查

english.text: The study cohort consisted of 16 samples from ten clinically aggressive meningiomas and two samples from two histologically defined WHO grade 1 meningiomas that were resected from 11 patients at UCSF from 2009 to 2022. Patient demographics, adjuvant treatments and clinical outcomes were recorded from the electronic medical record (Supplementary Tables 1 and 6). Magnetic resonance imaging studies were reviewed to define meningioma locations and clinical outcomes. Detailed pathologic examination of the entire cohort was performed by a board-certified neuropathologist (C.-H.G.L.) to assess for histological or molecular heterogeneity. Histological and molecular grading were assigned using the 2021 WHO Classification of Central Nervous System Tumors14. For bulk sequencing analyses, meningioma tissue was isolated from FFPE blocks using biopsy punches (Integra Miltex Instruments, cat. no. 33-31-P/25). Genomic DNA was extracted from macro-dissected FFPE tumor tissue using QIAamp DNA (Qiagen, cat. no. 56404) and QIAamp RNeasy FFPE Tissue Kits (Qiagen, cat. no. 73504) at UCSF. For spatial profiling assays, 6 mm cores were punched from FFPE blocks using biopsy punches, and serial sections were mounted onto glass slides for spatial transcriptomic, protein profiling, H&E histology or immunohistochemistry. DV200% values were calculated for candidate cases using an RNA 6000 Nano Kit (Agilent, cat. no. 5067-1511) and 2100 Bioanalyzer Expert Software (vB.02.10) to ensure high-quality RNA for analysis. Clinically validated immunohistochemistry for Ki-67 (DAKO, 1:50 dilution, MIB1 clone, cat. no. M7240), H3K27me3 (Cell Signaling, 1:50 dilution, C36B11 clone, cat. no. 9733) and p16 (Microfabricated Tissue Models Laboratory, undiluted, E6H4 clone, cat. no. 9511) was performed at UCSF on core mounts with appropriate controls using a Leica Bond III platform and imaged using light microscopy on a BX43 microscope with standard objectives (Olympus). Images were obtained and analyzed using the Olympus cellSens Standard Imaging Software package (v1.16).

chinese.text: 研究队列由来自 10 个临床侵袭性脑膜瘤的 16 个样本和来自两个组织学定义的 WHO 1 级脑膜瘤的两个样本组成，这些样本是从 2009 年至 2022 年在 UCSF 的 11 名患者身上切除的。患者人口统计、辅助治疗和临床结果均从电子病历中记录（补充表 1 和 6）。回顾了磁共振成像研究，以确定脑膜瘤的位置和临床结果。由委员会认证的神经病理学家 (C.-H.G.L.) 对整个队列进行详细的病理检查，以评估组织学或分子异质性。使用 2021 年 WHO 中枢神经系统肿瘤分类 14 进行组织学和分子分级。对于批量测序分析，使用活检穿孔器（Integra Miltex Instruments，目录号 33-31-P/25）从 FFPE 块中分离出脑膜瘤组织。使用 UCSF 的 QIAamp DNA（Qiagen，目录号 56404）和 QIAamp RNeasy FFPE 组织试剂盒（Qiagen，目录号 73504）从宏观解剖的 FFPE 肿瘤组织中提取基因组 DNA。对于空间分析测定，使用活检打孔器从 FFPE 块上打出 6 mm 的核心，并将连续切片安装到载玻片上以进行空间转录组学、蛋白质分析、H&E 组织学或免疫组织化学。使用 RNA 6000 Nano 试剂盒（安捷伦，目录号 5067-1511）和 2100 Bioanalyzer Expert 软件（vB.02.10）计算候选病例的 DV200% 值，以确保用于分析的高质量 RNA。 Ki-67（DAKO，1:50 稀释，MIB1 克隆，目录号 M7240）、H3K27me3（Cell Signaling，1:50 稀释，C36B11 克隆，目录号 9733）和 p16（微制造组织模型实验室，未稀释，E6H4 克隆，目录号 9511）进行了临床验证的免疫组织化学分析，使用 Leica Bond III 平台进行适当控制的核心安装座上的 UCSF，并使用带有标准物镜 (Olympus) 的 BX43 显微镜上的光学显微镜进行成像。使用奥林巴斯 cellSens 标准成像软件包 (v1.16) 获取并分析图像。

source_fragments: The study cohort consisted of 16 samples from ten clinically aggressive meningiomas and two samples from two histologically defined WHO grade 1 meningiomas that were resected from 11 patients at UCSF from 2009 to 2022. Patient demographics, adjuvant treatments and clinical outcomes were recorded from the electronic medical record (Supplementary Tables 1 and 6). Magnetic resonance imaging studies were reviewed to define meningioma locations and clinical outcomes. Detailed pathologic examination of the entire cohort was performed by a board-certified neuropathologist (C.-H.G.L.) to assess for histological or molecular heterogeneity. Histological and molecular grading were assigned using the 2021 WHO Classification of Central Nervous System Tumors14. For bulk sequencing analyses, meningioma tissue was isolated from FFPE blocks using biopsy punches (Integra Miltex Instruments, cat. no. 33-31-P/25). Genomic DNA was extracted from macro-dissected FFPE tumor tissue using QIAamp DNA (Qiagen, cat. no. 56404) and QIAamp RNeasy FFPE Tissue Kits (Qiagen, cat. no. 73504) at UCSF. For spatial profiling assays, 6 mm cores were punched from FFPE blocks using biopsy punches, and serial sections were mounted onto glass slides for spatial transcriptomic, protein profiling, H&E histology or immunohistochemistry. DV200% values were calculated for candidate cases using an RNA 6000 Nano Kit (Agilent, cat. no. 5067-1511) and 2100 Bioanalyzer Expert Software (vB.02.10) to ensure high-quality RNA for analysis. Clinically validated immunohistochemistry for Ki-67 (DAKO, 1:50 dilution, MIB1 clone, cat. no. M7240), H3K27me3 (Cell Signaling, 1:50 dilution, C36B11 clone, cat. no. 9733) and p16 (Microfabricated Tissue Models Laboratory, undiluted, E6H4 clone, cat. no. 9511) was performed at UCSF on core mounts with appropriate controls using a Leica Bond III platform and imaged using light microscopy on a BX43 microscope with standard objectives (Olympus). Images were obtained and analyzed using the Olympus cellSens Standard Imaging Software package (v1.16).

english.text: Genomic DNA underwent bisulfite conversion using the EZ DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research, cat. no. D5004), followed by amplification, fragmentation and hybridization to Infinium EPIC 850k Human DNA Methylation BeadChips (Illumina, cat. no. 20020530) according to the manufacturer’s instructions at the Molecular Genomics Core at the University of Southern California (Los Angeles, CA, USA). Bioinformatic analysis was performed in R (v3.6.1). Meningioma DNA methylation data were preprocessed using the SeSAMe pipeline (Bioconductor v3.10) as previously described6,65. In brief, probes were filtered and analyzed using normal-exponential out-of-band background correction, nonlinear dye bias correction, P value with out-of-band array hybridization masking and β value calculation (β = methylated/ (methylated+unmethylated)). Meningioma samples were assigned to merlin-intact, immune-enriched or hypermitotic DNA methylation groups using a support vector machine classifier, as previously described6.

chinese.text: 使用 EZ DNA 甲基化试剂盒（Zymo Research，目录号 D5004）对基因组 DNA 进行亚硫酸氢盐转化，然后根据南加州大学（美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶）分子基因组学核心制造商的说明，进行扩增、片段化并与 Infinium EPIC 850k 人类 DNA 甲基化 BeadChips（Illumina，目录号 20020530）杂交。在 R (v3.6.1) 中进行生物信息分析。如前所述，脑膜瘤 DNA 甲基化数据使用 SeSAMe 管道 (Bioconductor v3.10) 进行预处理6,65。简而言之，使用正态指数带外背景校正、非线性染料偏差校正、带外阵列杂交掩蔽的 P 值和 β 值计算（β = 甲基化/（甲基化+非甲基化））对探针进行过滤和分析。如前所述，使用支持向量机分类器将脑膜瘤样本分配到完整的 merlin、免疫富集或有丝分裂过度的 DNA 甲基化组6。

sections.title_zh: 靶向 DNA 测序和分析

english.text: Targeted DNA sequencing was performed using the UCSF500 NGS panel, as previously described23. In brief, this capture-based next-generation DNA sequencing assay targets all coding exons of 479 cancer-related genes, select introns and upstream regulatory regions of 47 genes to enable the detection of structural variants such as gene fusions and DNA segments at regular intervals along each chromosome; this facilitates genome-wide copy number and zygosity analyses, with a total sequencing footprint of 2.8 Mb (

). Multiplex library preparation was performed using the KAPA Hyper Prep Kit (Roche, cat. no. 07962355001). Hybrid capture of pooled libraries was performed using a custom oligonucleotide library (Nimblegen SeqCap EZ Choice). Captured libraries were sequenced as paired-end reads on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 at >200× coverage for each sample. Sequence reads were mapped to the reference human genome build GRCh37 (hg19) using the Burrows–Wheeler aligner (v0.7.17). Recalibration and deduplication of reads were performed using the Genome Analysis Toolkit (v4.3.0.0). Coverage and sequencing statistics were determined using Picard (v2.27.5) CalculateHsMetrics and Collect- InsertSizeMetrics. Single nucleotide variant and small insertion and/ or deletion mutation calling was performed with FreeBayes, Unified Genotyper and Pindel. Large insertion and/or deletion and structural alteration calling was performed with Delly. Variant annotation was performed with Annovar. Single nucleotide variants, insertions and/ or deletions and structural variants were visualized and verified using Integrative Genome Viewer (v.2.16.0). Genome-wide copy number and zygosity analyses were performed using CNVkit and visualized using NxClinical (Biodiscovery, v6.0).

chinese.text: 如前所述，使用 UCSF500 NGS panel 进行靶向 DNA 测序23。简而言之，这种基于捕获的下一代 DNA 测序分析以 479 个癌症相关基因的所有编码外显子为目标，选择 47 个基因的内含子和上游调控区域，从而能够沿着每条染色体定期检测基因融合和 DNA 片段等结构变异；这有利于全基因组拷贝数和接合性分析，总测序足迹为 2.8 Mb（补充表 2）。使用 KAPA Hyper Prep Kit（Roche，目录号 07962355001）进行多重文库制备。使用定制寡核苷酸文库（Nimblegen SeqCap EZ Choice）对混合文库进行混合捕获。捕获的文库在 Illumina NovaSeq 6000 上以双端读数的形式进行测序，每个样本的覆盖度 >200 倍。使用 Burrows–Wheeler 比对器 (v0.7.17) 将序列读数映射到参考人类基因组构建 GRCh37 (hg19)。使用基因组分析工具包 (v4.3.0.0) 进行读取的重新校准和重复数据删除。使用 Picard (v2.27.5)CalculateHsMetrics 和 Collect-InsertSizeMetrics 确定覆盖率和测序统计数据。使用 FreeeBayes、Unified Genotyper 和 Pindel 进行单核苷酸变异和小插入和/或缺失突变识别。大插入和/或删除以及结构改变调用是用Delly进行的。使用 Annovar 进行变异注释。使用 Integrative Genome Viewer (v.2.16.0) 对单核苷酸变异、插入和/或缺失以及结构变异进行可视化和验证。使用 CNVkit 进行全基因组拷贝数和接合性分析，并使用 NxClinical（Biodiscovery，v6.0）进行可视化。

english.text: Targeted gene expression profiling was performed using a hybridization and barcode-based RNA sequencing NanoString panel, with quality control from internal negative and spike-in positive controls on the NanoString nCounter Analysis System at the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Core (San Francisco, CA, USA). In brief, 200 ng of total RNA per sample was hybridized to barcoded reporter probes and biotin-conjugated capture probes from a custom codeset targeting genes of interest at 65 °C for 16 h according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Hybridization mixtures were washed and target–probe complexes were purified and bound to streptavidin-coated cartridges. Cartridges were scanned on the nCounter Digital Analyzer with a field of view setting of 550. Gene expression risk scores spanning 0 to 1, with a greater value denoting higher risk of recurrence, were calculated using a previously trained and validated algorithm based on Lasso Cox regression and bootstrap aggregation using log2-transformed, housekeeping-gene-normalized gene expression counts from a 34-gene signature as inputs. Previously identified cutoffs were used (low risk ≤ 0.3761, high risk > 0.5652)21.

chinese.text: 使用杂交和基于条形码的 RNA 测序 NanoString panel 进行靶向基因表达谱分析，并在旧金山退伍军人事务中心（美国加利福尼亚州旧金山）的 NanoString nCounter 分析系统上通过内部阴性对照和掺入阳性对照进行质量控制。简而言之，根据制造商的说明，每个样品 200 ng 的总 RNA 与来自针对感兴趣基因的定制代码集的条形码报告探针和生物素缀合的捕获探针杂交 16 小时。洗涤杂交混合物，纯化靶标-探针复合物并结合到链霉亲和素包被的柱上。在视场设置为 550 的 nCounter 数字分析仪上扫描试剂盒。基因表达风险评分从 0 到 1，数值越大表示复发风险越高，使用基于 Lasso Cox 回归和 bootstrap 聚合的先前训练和验证的算法进行计算，使用来自 34 个基因签名的 log2 转换、管家基因标准化基因表达计数作为输入。使用之前确定的临界值（低风险 ≤ 0.3761，高风险 > 0.5652）21。

sections.title_zh: 空间转录组测序和分析

english.text: Spatial transcriptomic profiling was performed on FFPE sections with DV200% values > 50% using the Visium HD Spatial Gene Expression assay (10x Genomics, v1, cat. no. 1000336). In brief, 6 mm cores were mounted within capture areas on Visium glass slides, deparaffinized, stained with H&E and imaged at the Gladstone Institutes Histology Core (San Francisco, CA, USA). Libraries were prepared according to the manufacturer’s instructions at the Gladstone Institutes Genomics Core (San Francisco, CA, USA). Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 instrument at the UCSF Center for Advanced Technology. Sequencing was performed with the recommended protocol (read 1, 28 cycles; i7 index read, 10 cycles; i5 index read, 10 cycles; and read 2, 91 cycles). FASTQ sequencing files and histology images were processed using the Space Ranger pipeline (10x Genomics) and the Visium Human Transcriptome Probe Set v1.0 GRCh38-2020-A (10x Genomics). Data were visualized using Loupe Browser software (10x Genomics, v6.3.0). PCA was run on a normalized, filtered feature-barcode matrix to reduce the number of feature (for example, gene) dimensions. UMAP analysis was used to visualize spatial transcriptomes in a 2D space. Graph-based clustering was performed to cluster spatial transcriptomes with related expression profiles together based on their concordance in PCA space.

chinese.text: 使用 Visium HD 空间基因表达测定（10x Genomics，v1，目录号 1000336）对 DV200% 值 > 50% 的 FFPE 切片进行空间转录组分析。简而言之，将 6 mm 核心安装在 Visium 载玻片的捕获区域内，脱蜡，用 H&E 染色，并在 Gladstone Institutes Histology Core（美国加利福尼亚州旧金山）成像。文库是根据 Gladstone Institutes Genomics Core（美国加利福尼亚州旧金山）制造商的说明制备的。文库在 UCSF 先进技术中心的 Illumina NovaSeq 6000 仪器上进行测序。按照推荐方案进行测序（读取 1，28 个循环；i7 索引读取，10 个循环；i5 索引读取，10 个循环；读取 2，91 个循环）。使用 Space Ranger pipeline (10x Genomics) 和 Visium Human Transcriptome Probe Set v1.0 GRCh38-2020-A (10x Genomics) 处理 FASTQ 测序文件和组织学图像。使用放大镜浏览器软件（10x Genomics，v6.3.0）将数据可视化。 PCA 在标准化、过滤的特征条形码矩阵上运行，以减少特征（例如基因）维度的数量。 UMAP 分析用于可视化二维空间中的空间转录组。基于图的聚类根据 PCA 空间中的一致性将具有相关表达谱的空间转录组聚类在一起。

english.text: Differential expression analyses were performed using mean gene expression in each cluster, log2 fold change of mean gene expression in a cluster relative to all other spatial transcriptomes and a P value denoting gene expression significance in each cluster relative to spatial transcriptomes in other clusters. P values in each cluster were adjusted for false discovery rate to account for the number of genes being tested. Heatmaps of spatial transcriptomic data were generated using the Loupe Browser software, which considers the top N genes for each cluster, sorted by log2(fold change) (by default, N = 120/X, where X is the total number of spatial transcriptome clusters). Heatmaps were generated using hierarchical clustering with Euclidean distance and average linkage.

chinese.text: 使用每个簇中的平均基因表达、簇中平均基因表达相对于所有其他空间转录组的log2倍数变化以及表示每个簇中相对于其他簇中的空间转录组的基因表达显着性的P值来进行差异表达分析。每个簇中的 P 值都根据错误发现率进行了调整，以考虑到正在测试的基因数量。使用 Loupe Browser 软件生成空间转录组数据的热图，该软件考虑每个簇的前 N ​​个基因，按 log2（倍数变化）排序（默认情况下，N = 120/X，其中 X 是空间转录组簇的总数）。热图是使用具有欧几里得距离和平均链接的层次聚类生成的。

P values in each cluster were adjusted for false discovery rate to account for the number of genes being tested. Heatmaps of spatial transcriptomic data were generated using the Loupe Browser software, which considers the top N genes for each cluster, sorted by log2(fold change) (by default, N = 120/X, where X is the total number of spatial transcriptome clusters). Heatmaps were generated using hierarchical clustering with Euclidean distance and average linkage.

english.text: Space Ranger-generated, filtered feature matrices were imported into a Seurat object (v4.3.0, arguments min.cells = 3, min.features = 100) using R (v4.2.1) and RStudio (v2022.07.2 build 576) (

). The individual count matrices were normalized by nFeature_RNA count (subset = nFeature_RNA > 1,500 and nFeature_RNA < 9,500) and integrated with Harmony (v0.1.1). Optimal cluster resolution was determined using Clustree (v0.5.0, analyzing resolutions 5, 2, 1, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.1 and 0.0), and subsequent principal component (npcs = 30) and UMAP (dims = 1:30, min.dist = 0.2) analyses were performed. UMAP projections and cluster distributions were visualized in the Loupe Browser after combining spatial transcriptomic data from individual capture areas using the ‘spaceranger aggr’ pipeline (10x Genomics, v2.0.0). CNV analysis from spatial transcriptomes was performed using inferCNV (v1.14.0) and spatialinferCNV (v0.1.0). Capture areas of interest were combined with an additional capture area containing a geographic population of non-neoplastic cells using the ‘spaceranger aggr’ pipeline (10x Genomics) and Harmony, as described above. The cluster distribution was visually assessed in the Loupe Browser to identify the cluster containing non-neoplastic tissue, such as brain or endothelial. All cluster annotations were exported into a csv file and imported into R along with the aggregate filtered feature matrix. The count matrix, annotated clusters and a gene order file were input into inferCNV (arguments were cutoff = 0.1, cluster_by_groups = TRUE, HMM = TRUE and denoise = TRUE) to generate a six-state CNV probability model for each spatial transcriptomic cluster. Deconvolution of meningioma cell types from single-cell RNA sequencing was performed using SCDC (v0.0.0.9000). To do so, each spatial transcriptome was treated as a pseudobulked RNA sequencing dataset and leveraged against known cell types from a reference single-cell RNA sequencing dataset comprising 57,114 cells from eight human meningioma samples representing all DNA methylation groups6. Spatial and single-cell transcriptomic data were separately processed for quality control using quality control filtering, normalization, dimensionality reduction and clustering. Single-cell transcriptomic data were subsampled to 1000 cells per cell type, and the top differentially expressed genes were selected for each cell type. Using this expression set, spatial transcriptomes were deconvolved to yield a matrix with predicted proportions of each cell type for each spatial transcriptome, which were visualized using SpatialFeatureplot (Seurat v3).

source_fragments: Space Ranger-generated, filtered feature matrices were imported into a Seurat object (v4.3.0, arguments min.cells = 3, min.features = 100) using R (v4.2.1) and RStudio (v2022.07.2 build 576) (Supplementary Table 4). The individual count matrices were normalized by nFeature_RNA count (subset = nFeature_RNA > 1,500 and nFeature_RNA < 9,500) and integrated with Harmony (v0.1.1). Optimal cluster resolution was determined using Clustree (v0.5.0, analyzing resolutions 5, 2, 1, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.1 and 0.0), and subsequent principal component (npcs = 30) and UMAP (dims = 1:30, min.dist = 0.2) analyses were performed. UMAP projections and cluster distributions were visualized in the Loupe Browser after combining spatial transcriptomic data from individual capture areas using the ‘spaceranger aggr’ pipeline (10x Genomics, v2.0.0). CNV analysis from spatial transcriptomes was performed using inferCNV (v1.14.0) and spatialinferCNV (v0.1.0). Capture areas of interest were combined with an additional capture area containing a geographic population of non-neoplastic cells using the ‘spaceranger aggr’ pipeline (10x Genomics) and Harmony, as described above. The cluster distribution was visually assessed in the Loupe Browser to identify the cluster containing non-neoplastic tissue, such as brain or endothelial. All cluster annotations were exported into a csv file and imported into R along with the aggregate filtered feature matrix. The count matrix, annotated clusters and a gene order file were input into inferCNV (arguments were cutoff = 0.1, cluster_by_groups = TRUE, HMM = TRUE and denoise = TRUE) to generate a six-state CNV probability model for each spatial transcriptomic cluster. Deconvolution of meningioma cell types from single-cell RNA sequencing was performed using SCDC (v0.0.0.9000). To do so, each spatial transcriptome was treated as a pseudobulked RNA sequencing dataset and leveraged against known cell types from a reference single-cell RNA sequencing dataset comprising 57,114 cells from eight human meningioma samples representing all DNA methylation groups6. Spatial and single-cell transcriptomic data were separately processed for quality control using quality control filtering, normalization, dimensionality reduction and clustering. Single-cell transcriptomic data were subsampled to 1000 cells per cell type, and the top differentially expressed genes were selected for each cell type. Using this expression set, spatial transcriptomes were deconvolved to yield a matrix with predicted proportions of each cell type for each spatial transcriptome, which were visualized using SpatialFeatureplot (Seurat v3).

english.text: Spatial protein profiling was performed on FFPE sections using the NanoString Digital Spatial Profiler at the UCSF Laboratory for Cell Analysis Genome Core (San Francisco, CA, USA). Meningioma sections were labeled with DAPI and a multiplexed cocktail of 72 oligo-conjugated antibodies (

) using human protein panel modules generated at NanoString Technologies (Seattle, WA, USA). H&E-stained whole slide images were overlayed on fluorescent DAPI projections, and 200 μm regions of interest were annotated based on histological and morphological heterogeneity by a board-certified neuropathologist (C.-H.G.L.). Oligonucleotides were released from regions of interest using ultraviolet cleavage, and aspirated tags were hybridized to optical barcodes and processed using the NanoString nCounter Analysis System. Barcodes were normalized with internal spike-in controls and then normalized against housekeeping genes. PCA was performed using the prcomp function in R (v3.6.1) using default settings.

english.text: Automated multiplexed seqIF staining and imaging were performed on FFPE sections at Northwestern University using the COMET platform (Lunaphore Technologies). The multiplexed panel comprised 29 antibodies (

). The 29-plex protocol was generated using COMET Control Software (v1.0), and the reagents were loaded onto the COMET device to perform seqIF. All antibodies were validated using conventional immunohistochemistry and/or immunofluorescence staining in conjunction with corresponding fluorophores and DAPI (Thermo Fisher Scientific, cat. no. 62248). For optimal concentration and the best signal-to-noise ratio, all antibodies were tested at three different dilutions, starting with the manufacturer-recommended dilution (MRD), MRD/2 and MRD/4. Secondary Alexa fluorophore 555 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, cat. no. A32727) and Alexa fluorophore 647 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, cat. no. A32733) were used at 1:200 or 1:400 dilutions, respectively. The optimizations and full runs of the multiplexed panel were executed using the seqIF technology integrated into the Lunaphore COMET platform (characterization 2 and 3 protocols, and seqIF protocols, respectively). The seqIF workflow was parallelized on a maximum of four slides, with automated cycles of iterative staining of two antibodies at a time, followed by imaging, and elution of the primary and secondary antibodies, with no sample manipulation during the entire workflow. All reagents were diluted in Multistaining Buffer (Lunaphore Technologies, cat. no. BU06). The elution step lasted 2 min for each cycle and was performed with Elution Buffer (Lunaphore Technologies, cat. no. BU07-L) at 37 °C. Quenching lasted for 30 s and was performed with Quenching Buffer (Lunaphore Technologies, cat. no. BU08-L). Imaging was performed with Imaging Buffer (Lunaphore Technologies, cat. no. BU09), with exposure times set at 4 min for all primary antibodies, except for the P16 antibody (8 min) and secondary antibodies (2 min). Imaging was performed with an integrated epifluorescent microscope at ×20 magnification. Image registration was performed immediately after concluding the staining and imaging procedures using COMET Control Software. Each seqIF protocol resulted in a multi-stack OME-TIFF file in which the imaging outputs from each cycle were stitched and aligned. COMET OME-TIFF files contain a DAPI image, intrinsic tissue autofluorescence in TRITC and Cy5 channels and a single fluorescent layer per marker. Markers were subsequently pseudocolored for visualization of multiplexed antibodies.

chinese.text: 使用 COMET 平台 (Lunaphore Technologies) 在西北大学的 FFPE 切片上进行自动多重 seqIF 染色和成像。多重检测组包含 29 种抗体（补充表 8）。使用 COMET 控制软件 (v1.0) 生成 29 重方案，并将试剂加载到 COMET 设备上以执行 seqIF。所有抗体均使用常规免疫组织化学和/或免疫荧光染色结合相应的荧光团和 DAPI（Thermo Fisher Scientific，目录号 62248）进行验证。为了获得最佳浓度和最佳信噪比，所有抗体均以三种不同的稀释度进行测试，从制造商推荐的稀释度 (MRD)、MRD/2 和 MRD/4 开始。二级 Alexa 荧光团 555（Thermo Fisher Scientific，目录号 A32727）和 Alexa 荧光团 647（Thermo Fisher Scientific，目录号 A32733）分别以 1:200 或 1:400 稀释度使用。使用集成到 Lunaphore COMET 平台中的 seqIF 技术（分别为表征 2 和 3 协议，以及 seqIF 协议）执行多路复用面板的优化和完整运行。 seqIF 工作流程在最多四张载玻片上并行，一次对两种抗体进行迭代染色的自动循环，然后进行成像以及一抗和二抗的洗脱，整个工作流程中没有样品操作。所有试剂均在多重染色缓冲液（Lunaphore Technologies，目录号 BU06）中稀释。每个循环的洗脱步骤持续 2 分钟，并使用洗脱缓冲液（Lunaphore Technologies，目录号 BU07-L）在 37 °C 下进行。淬火持续 30 秒，并使用淬火缓冲液（Lunaphore Technologies，目录号 BU08-L）进行。使用成像缓冲液（Lunaphore Technologies，目录号 BU09）进行成像，所有一抗的曝光时间设置为 4 分钟，P16 抗体（8 分钟）和二抗（2 分钟）除外。使用集成落射荧光显微镜以 20 倍放大倍率进行成像。使用 COMET 控制软件完成染色和成像程序后立即进行图像配准。每个 seqIF 协议都会生成一个多堆栈 OME-TIFF 文件，其中每个周期的成像输出都经过缝合和对齐。 COMET OME-TIFF 文件包含 DAPI 图像、TRITC 和 Cy5 通道中的固有组织自发荧光以及每个标记的单个荧光层。随后将标记物伪彩色化以实现多重抗体的可视化。

english.text: RNA was extracted from M10G cells using an RNeasy Plus Mini Kit (Qiagen, cat. no. 74134), and cDNA was synthesized using the iScript cDNA Synthesis Kit (Bio-Rad, cat. no. 1708891). Target genes were amplified using PowerUp SYBR Green Master Mix and a QuantStudio 6 thermocycler (Thermo Fisher Scientific). Gene expression was calculated using the DDCt method, with normalization to GAPDH (sense, 5′-ATGGGGAAGGTGAAGGTCG-3′; antisense, 5′-GGGGTCATTGATGGCAACAATA-3′). Target gene primers included CDKN2A (sense, 5′-ATGGAGCCTTCGGCTGACT-3′; antisense, 5′-GTAACTATTCGGTGCGTTGGG-3′), CDKN2B (sense, 5′-ACGGAGTC AACCGTTTCGGGAG-3′; antisense, 5′-GGTCGGGTGAGAGTGGCAGG-3′) and ARID1A (sense, 5′-CCTGAAGAACTCGAACGGGAA-3′; antisense, 5′-TCCGCCATGTTGTTGGTGG-3′).

sections.title_en: Cell culture RNA sequencing and analysis

english.text: RNA was extracted from triplicate M10G cultures (sgNTC, sgCDKN2A, sgCDKN2B and sgARID1A) using an RNeasy Plus Mini Kit (Qiagen, cat. no. 74134). Then, 1 μg of RNA from each condition was shipped to Medgenome (Foster City, CA, USA) for bulk RNA sequencing (

). Quality control was performed using FASTQC (v0.11.9), and the results were aggregated using MultiQC (v1.12). Adapter sequences and bases with quality scores < 30 at the 3′ and 5′ ends of the reads were trimmed using Cutadapt (v3.7). Trimmed reads that were less than 20 bases in length were discarded. Processed reads were mapped to the reference genome GRCh38 using HISAT2 (v2.2.0) with default parameters. FeatureCounts (v2.0.0) was used to extract gene expression counts. The resulting count matrix was used to perform differential gene expression analysis with DESeq2 (v1.36.0).

chinese.text: 使用 RNeasy Plus Mini Kit（Qiagen，目录号 74134）从一式三份的 M10G 培养物（sgNTC、sgCDKN2A、sgCDKN2B 和 sgARID1A）中提取 RNA。然后，将每种条件下的 1 μg RNA 运送至 Medgenome（美国加利福尼亚州福斯特城）进行批量 RNA 测序（补充表 10）。使用 FASTQC (v0.11.9) 进行质量控制，并使用 MultiQC (v1.12) 汇总结果。使用 Cutadapt (v3.7) 修剪读数 3' 和 5' 末端质量分数 < 30 的接头序列和碱基。长度小于 20 个碱基的修剪读数被丢弃。使用 HISAT2 (v2.2.0) 和默认参数将处理后的读数映射到参考基因组 GRCh38。 FeatureCounts (v2.0.0) 用于提取基因表达计数。所得计数矩阵用于通过 DESeq2 (v1.36.0) 进行差异基因表达分析。

source_fragments: RNA was extracted from triplicate M10G cultures (sgNTC, sgCDKN2A, sgCDKN2B and sgARID1A) using an RNeasy Plus Mini Kit (Qiagen, cat. no. 74134). Then, 1 μg of RNA from each condition was shipped to Medgenome (Foster City, CA, USA) for bulk RNA sequencing (Supplementary Table 10). Quality control was performed using FASTQC (v0.11.9), and the results were aggregated using MultiQC (v1.12). Adapter sequences and bases with quality scores < 30 at the 3′ and 5′ ends of the reads were trimmed using Cutadapt (v3.7). Trimmed reads that were less than 20 bases in length were discarded. Processed reads were mapped to the reference genome GRCh38 using HISAT2 (v2.2.0) with default parameters. FeatureCounts (v2.0.0) was used to extract gene expression counts. The resulting count matrix was used to perform differential gene expression analysis with DESeq2 (v1.36.0).

english.text: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA, v4.3.2) was performed to determine whether differentially expressed genes in M10G cultures belonged to common biological pathways. Gene rank scores were calculated using the following formula: sign(log2 fold change) × −log10 (P value). Pathways were defined using the gene set file Human_GOBP_ AllPathways_no_GO_iea_December_01_2022_symbol.gmt, which is maintained by the Bader laboratory. Gene set size was limited to a range between 15 and 500, and positive and negative enrichment files were generated using 2,000 permutations. The EnrichmentMap App (v3.3.4) in Cytoscape (v3.7.2) was used to visualize the results of pathway analysis. Nodes with false discovery rate q < 0.05 and P < 0.05 and nodes sharing gene overlaps with a Jaccard + Overlap Combined (JOC) threshold of 0.375 were connected by blue lines (edges) to generate network maps. Clusters of related pathways were identified and annotated using the AutoAnnotate App (v1.3.5) in Cytoscape that uses a Markov Cluster algorithm to connect pathways using shared keywords in the description of each pathway. The resulting groups of pathways were designated as the consensus pathways in a circle.

chinese.text: 进行基因集富集分析（GSEA，v4.3.2）以确定M10G培养物中差异表达的基因是否属于常见的生物学途径。使用以下公式计算基因排名分数：sign(log2倍数变化)×-log10(P值)。使用基因集文件 Human_GOBP_ AllPathways_no_GO_iea_December_01_2022_symbol.gmt 定义通路，该文件由 Bader 实验室维护。基因集大小限制在 15 到 500 之间，并使用 2,000 个排列生成正负富集文件。 Cytoscape (v3.7.2) 中的 EnrichmentMap App (v3.3.4) 用于可视化通路分析的结果。错误发现率 q < 0.05 且 P < 0.05 的节点以及共享基因重叠且杰卡德 + 重叠组合 (JOC) 阈值为 0.375 的节点通过蓝线（边）连接以生成网络图。使用 Cytoscape 中的 AutoAnnotate 应用程序 (v1.3.5) 识别和注释相关路径的簇，该应用程序使用马尔可夫簇算法在每个路径的描述中使用共享关键字来连接路径。由此产生的路径组被指定为圆圈中的共识路径。

sections.title_zh: 脑膜瘤共培养药理学和显微镜检查

english.text: CRISPRi-modified and fluorescently labeled M10GdCas9-KRAB, IOMM-LeedCas9-Zim3-KRAB and BenMen-1dCas9-Zim3-KRAB meningioma cells were generated for 3D co-culture experiments by mixing sgNTC-mScarlet with sgCDKN2A-mGFP cells, sgNTC-mGFP with sgARID1A-mCherry cells or sgCDKN2A-mGFP with sgARID1A-mCherry cells in a 1:1 ratio. For pharmacologic experiments, a minimum of 300 cells were seeded into each well of a PrimeSurface ultra-low attachment V-shaped 96-well plate (S-Bio, cat. no. MS-9096V). The following day, meningioma co-cultures were transferred to a spheroid microplate (Corning, cat. no. 4515) before 12 days of continuous drug treatment. Co-cultures were maintained in a medium consisting of Advanced DMEM/F-12 (Gibco, cat. no. 12634) supplemented with B-27 supplement without vitamin A (Gibco, cat. no. 12587010), N-2 supplement (Gibco, cat. no. 17502048), 100 U ml−1 Antibiotic-Antimycotic (Gibco, cat. no. 15240), 1% CTS GlutaMAX-I (Gibco, cat. no. A1286001), 20 ng ml−1 EGF (R&D Systems, cat. no. 236EG200) and 20 ng ml−1 FGF basic/FGF2 (R&D Systems, cat. no. PRD23350). A Cell Observer Spinning Disc Confocal Microscope (Zeiss) fitted with a temperature-controlled and carbon dioxide-controlled chamber was used to acquire fluorescence images of live meningioma co-cultures during drug treatments using Plan-Apochromat ×10/1.3 air objective.

english.text: To test the effect of small molecule inhibitors such as abemaciclib (MCE, cat. no. HY-16297A), selumetinib (Selleck Chemicals, cat. no S1008) and copansilib (MCE, cat. no HY-15346), SF12964 cells at a concentration of 5×103 cells per well were seeded on a 96-well plate and maintained for 2 days in Advanced DMEM/F-12 medium (Gibco, cat. no. 12634) supplemented with 5% FBS (Gibco, cat. no. 26140), B-27 supplement without vitamin A (Gibco, cat. no. 12587010), N-2 supplement (Gibco, cat. no. 17502048), 1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic (Gibco, cat. no. 15240), 1% GlutaMAX-I (Gibco, cat. no. english.text: Statistics All experiments were performed with independent biological replicates and repeated, and statistics were derived from biological replicates. Biological replicates are indicated in each figure panel or figure legend. No statistical methods were used to predetermine sample sizes, but sample sizes in this study are similar or larger to those reported in previous publications. Data distribution was assumed to be normal, but this was not formally tested. Investigators were blinded to the various conditions during clinical data collection and analysis of mechanistic or functional studies. Bioinformatic analyses were performed blind to clinical features, outcomes or molecular characteristics. The clinical samples used in this study were retrospective and nonrandomized with no intervention, and all samples were interrogated equally. Thus, controlling for covariates among clinical samples is not relevant. Cells and animals were randomized to experimental conditions. No clinical, molecular or cellular data points were excluded from the analyses. Unless specified otherwise, lines represent means, and error bars represent s.e.m. Results were compared using Student’s t-tests, which are indicated in figure legends alongside approaches used to adjust for multiple comparisons. In general, statistical significance is shown by asterisks (*P ≤ 0.05, **P ≤ 0.01 and ***P ≤ 0.0001), but exact P values are provided in the figure legends when possible.

assets.caption_en: Extended Data Fig. 10 | Validation of pharmacological strategies to overcome intratumor heterogeneity in high-grade meningiomas. a, M10G patientderived meningioma cells stably expressing CRISPRi machinery (dCas9-KRAB) and sgRNAs suppressing CDKN2A (sgCDKN2A, n = 3), CDKN2B (sgCDKN2B, n = 4), ARID1A (sgARID1A, n = 6), or non-targeted control sgRNAs (sgNTC, n = 3, 4, 6, respectively). Cells were labeled with red or green fluorescence proteins and integrated into 3D co-cultures for pharmacologic and live cell imaging experiments. b, IOMM-Lee meningioma cells that lack endogenous CDKN2A/B stably expressing CRISPRi machinery (dCas9-Zim3) and sgARID1A (n = 4) or sgNTC (n = 4). Cells were labeled with red or green fluorescence proteins and integrated into 3D co-cultures for pharmacologic and live cell imaging experiments. c, Combination molecular therapy treatments of 3D co-cultures of IOMM-LeedCas9-Zim3 meningioma cells expressing sgARID1A or sgNTC. Scale bar, 100μm. d, Quantification of combination molecular therapy treatments of 3D co-cultures of IOMM-LeedCas9-Zim3 meningioma cells expressing sgARID1A or sgNTC. Representative of 8 biological replicates per condition. e, MTT cell viability results normalized to vehicle control after 5 days of molecular therapy of SF12964, a patient-derived meningioma cell line from a WHO grade 3 meningioma (Hypermitotic DNA methylation group, NF2 p.Q165* mutation, chromosome 1p and 22q deletion, CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion, chromosome 1q amplification) that underwent reoperation after 5 months of abemaciclib treatment following prior surgeries and prior radiotherapy treatments. Representative of 8 biological replicates per condition. Lines represent means and error bars represent standard error of the means. Student’s t tests, one-sided, **P ≤ 0.01, ***P ≤ 0.0001.

Multiplex library preparation was performed using the KAPA Hyper Prep Kit (Roche, cat. no. 07962355001). Hybrid capture of pooled librar- ies was performed using a custom oligonucleotide library (Nimblegen SeqCap EZ Choice). Captured libraries were sequenced as paired-end reads on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 at >200× coverage for each sample. Sequence reads were mapped to the reference human genome build GRCh37 (hg19) using the Burrows–Wheeler aligner (v0.7.17). Recalibra- tion and deduplication of reads were performed using the Genome Analysis Toolkit (v4.3.0.0). Coverage and sequencing statistics were determined using Picard (v2.27.5) CalculateHsMetrics and Collect- InsertSizeMetrics. Single nucleotide variant and small insertion and/ or deletion mutation calling was performed with FreeBayes, Unified Genotyper and Pindel. Large insertion and/or deletion and structural alteration calling was performed with Delly. Variant annotation was performed with Annovar. Single nucleotide variants, insertions and/ or deletions and structural variants were visualized and verified using Integrative Genome Viewer (v.2.16.0). Genome-wide copy number and zygosity analyses were performed using CNVkit and visualized using NxClinical (Biodiscovery, v6.0). Targeted RNA sequencing and analysis Targeted gene expression profiling was performed using a hybridi- zation and barcode-based RNA sequencing NanoString panel, with quality control from internal negative and spike-in positive controls on the NanoString nCounter Analysis System at the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Core (San Francisco, CA, USA). In brief, 200 ng of total RNA per sample was hybridized to barcoded reporter probes and biotin-conjugated capture probes from a custom codeset target- ing genes of interest at 65 °C for 16 h according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Hybridization mixtures were washed and target–probe complexes were purified and bound to streptavidin-coated cartridges. Cartridges were scanned on the nCounter Digital Analyzer with a field of view setting of 550. Gene expression risk scores spanning 0 to 1, with a greater value denoting higher risk of recurrence, were calculated using a previously trained and validated algorithm based on Lasso Cox regression and bootstrap aggregation using log2-transformed, housekeeping-gene-normalized gene expression counts from a 34-gene signature as inputs. Previously identified cutoffs were used (low risk ≤ 0.3761, high risk > 0.5652)21. Spatial transcriptome sequencing and analysis Spatial transcriptomic profiling was performed on FFPE sections with DV200% values > 50% using the Visium HD Spatial Gene Expression assay (10x Genomics, v1, cat. no. 1000336). In brief, 6 mm cores were mounted within capture areas on Visium glass slides, deparaffinized, stained with H&E and imaged at the Gladstone Institutes Histology Core (San Francisco, CA, USA). Libraries were prepared according to the manufacturer’s instructions at the Gladstone Institutes Genomics Core (San Francisco, CA, USA). Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 instrument at the UCSF Center for Advanced Technol- ogy. Sequencing was performed with the recommended protocol (read 1, 28 cycles; i7 index read, 10 cycles; i5 index read, 10 cycles; and read 2, 91 cycles). FASTQ sequencing files and histology images were processed using the Space Ranger pipeline (10x Genomics) and the Visium Human Transcriptome Probe Set v1.0 GRCh38-2020-A (10x Genomics). Data were visualized using Loupe Browser software (10x Genomics, v6.3.0). PCA was run on a normalized, filtered feature-barcode matrix to reduce the number of feature (for example, gene) dimensions. UMAP analysis was used to visualize spatial transcriptomes in a 2D space. Graph-based clustering was performed to cluster spatial transcriptomes with related expression profiles together based on their concordance in PCA space. hybridized to optical barcodes and processed using the NanoString nCounter Analysis System. Barcodes were normalized with internal spike-in controls and then normalized against housekeeping genes. PCA was performed using the prcomp function in R (v3.6.1) using default settings. Multiplexed seqIF and microscopy Automated multiplexed seqIF staining and imaging were performed on FFPE sections at Northwestern University using the COMET platform (Lunaphore Technologies). The multiplexed panel comprised 29 anti- bodies (Supplementary Table 8). The 29-plex protocol was generated using COMET Control Software (v1.0), and the reagents were loaded onto the COMET device to perform seqIF. All antibodies were validated using conventional immunohistochemistry and/or immunofluores- cence staining in conjunction with corresponding fluorophores and DAPI (Thermo Fisher Scientific, cat. no. 62248). For optimal concentra- tion and the best signal-to-noise ratio, all antibodies were tested at three different dilutions, starting with the manufacturer-recommended dilution (MRD), MRD/2 and MRD/4. Secondary Alexa fluorophore 555 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, cat. no. A32727) and Alexa fluorophore 647 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, cat. no. A32733) were used at 1:200 or 1:400 dilutions, respectively. The optimizations and full runs of the multiplexed panel were executed using the seqIF technology inte- grated into the Lunaphore COMET platform (characterization 2 and 3 protocols, and seqIF protocols, respectively). The seqIF workflow was parallelized on a maximum of four slides, with automated cycles of iterative staining of two antibodies at a time, followed by imaging, and elution of the primary and secondary antibodies, with no sample manipulation during the entire workflow. All reagents were diluted in Multistaining Buffer (Lunaphore Technologies, cat. no. BU06). The elution step lasted 2 min for each cycle and was performed with Elution Buffer (Lunaphore Technologies, cat. no. BU07-L) at 37 °C. Quenching lasted for 30 s and was performed with Quenching Buffer (Lunaphore Technologies, cat. no. BU08-L). Imaging was performed with Imaging Buffer (Lunaphore Technologies, cat. no. BU09), with exposure times set at 4 min for all primary antibodies, except for the P16 antibody (8 min) and secondary antibodies (2 min). Statistics All experiments were performed with independent biological repli- cates and repeated, and statistics were derived from biological repli- cates. Biological replicates are indicated in each figure panel or figure legend. No statistical methods were used to predetermine sample sizes, but sample sizes in this study are similar or larger to those reported in previous publications. Data distribution was assumed to be normal, but this was not formally tested. Investigators were blinded to the various conditions during clinical data collection and analysis of mechanistic or functional studies. Bioinformatic analyses were performed blind to clinical features, outcomes or molecular characteristics. The clinical samples used in this study were retrospective and nonrandomized with no intervention, and all samples were interrogated equally. Thus, controlling for covariates among clinical samples is not relevant. Cells and animals were randomized to experimental conditions. No clinical, molecular or cellular data points were excluded from the analyses. Unless specified otherwise, lines represent means, and error bars represent s.e.m.
